capabilities: run BioUnix commands via biounix fenced code blocks
chat with the BioUnix Agent in a sidebar view
send vault files to the Agent for analysis
scan the vault for bioinformatics files and generate a report
extras: Requires the BioUnix desktop app running locally; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run bioinformatics commands or interact with the BioUnix desktop app from inside notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin integrates BioUnix with Obsidian. It connects to the local BioUnix API Server

requires.name: BioUnix desktop app with local API Server
API token (auto-read from ~/.biounix/api-token or set manually)

summary: BioUnix integration that runs bioinformatics commands in fenced code blocks, chats with an Agent, and scans the vault for bioinformatics files.
